name: itinerary
title: Artist itinerary draft
for_each: select id,code from bookings where status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Travel, UTC timestamps
sections.sql: select name,departs_at,arrives_at,origin,destination,reference from journeys where booking_id=$1 order by departs_at

sections.title: Preparation
sections.sql: select name,category,due_on,completed_on,evidence_ref from advance_items where booking_id=$1 order by due_on

sections.title: Notes
sections.sql: select notes,owner from bookings where id=$1

sections.title: Receipts recorded by the operator
sections.sql: select reference,amount_cents,received_on,actor from receipts where booking_id=$1 order by received_on
